name: SIMBAD_query_object
description: Query SIMBAD by object name, coordinates, or wildcard identifier. Coordinate and identifier responses are exactly paginated within the returned script response using offset/next_offset. SIMBAD script output has no upstream total or overflow flag, so metadata.upstream_result_set_complete is null; use SIMBAD_advanced_query when broad-query overflow detection is required. Script errors retain the upstream message instead of being mislabeled as 'object not found'.

query_type.description: Type of query to perform. Options: 'object_name' (search by name), 'coordinates' (search by position), 'identifier' (search by identifier pattern)

object_name.description: Name of the astronomical object (e.g., 'M31', 'Sirius', 'NGC 1068'). Required when query_type='object_name'

ra.description: Right Ascension in degrees (0-360). Required when query_type='coordinates'

dec.description: Declination in degrees (-90 to +90). Required when query_type='coordinates'

radius.description: Search radius in arcminutes for coordinate queries. Default is 1.0 arcmin

identifier.description: Identifier pattern with wildcards (e.g., 'HD *', 'NGC 10*'). Required when query_type='identifier'

output_format.description: Level of detail in output. Options: 'basic' (ID, coordinates, type), 'detailed' (includes spectral type and flux), 'full' (all available data)

max_results.description: Maximum rows on this local response page

offset.description: Zero-based offset into the rows returned by the SIMBAD script response; continue with metadata.next_offset

results.description: Array of astronomical objects matching the query

spectral_type.description: Spectral type (if available and format is detailed/full)

flux.description: Flux measurements (if available and format is detailed/full)

author: ToolUniverse Contributors

name: SIMBAD_advanced_query
description: Execute ADQL against SIMBAD TAP with explicit truncation detection. JSON requests use a MAXREC+1 probe and return at most max_results rows; VOTable requests inspect QUERY_STATUS=OVERFLOW. metadata.has_more and result_set_complete prevent a MAXREC-limited response from appearing complete.

adql_query.description: ADQL query string. Example: 'SELECT TOP 10 main_id, ra, dec, otype FROM basic WHERE otype='Star' AND ra BETWEEN 0 AND 10'

max_results.description: Maximum rows to return; overflow is reported in metadata

query.description: The ADQL query that was executed

results.description: Query results in requested format (JSON object or VOTable XML string)

test_examples.adql_query: SELECT TOP 5 main_id, ra, dec, otype FROM basic WHERE otype='Star' AND ra BETWEEN 0 AND 10
SELECT main_id, pmra, pmdec FROM basic WHERE main_id='Sirius'
